The energy value of alcoholic beverages can be determined 
using the following equation:
Alcohol kcal 5 amount of beverage (oz) x proof 
x .8 kcal/proof/oz.
Proof is the proportion of alcohol to water or other liq-
uids in an alcoholic beverage. The standard in the United 
States defines 100-proof as equal to 50% of ethyl alcohol by 
volume. To determine the percentage of ethyl alcohol in a 
beverage, divide the proof value by 2. For example, 86-proof 
whiskey contains 43% ethyl alcohol. The latter part of the
